text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding sample-app routed traffic to our org key after a project-key rotation. Quick repro below.

maria: Repro: set RW_API_KEY_PROJECT, run `make start`, rotate project key in console; subsequent requests billed to REDWOOD_API_KEY.

devon: Confirmed. SDK v1.4 changed env loading order; it now picks REDWOOD_API_KEY before RW_API_KEY_PROJECT. Logs: auth: selected key=REDWOOD_API_KEY (org) -> request Authorization: Bearer <org-key>.

devon: Minimal repro snippet:
```\nexport REDWOOD_API_KEY=\"org-xxxx\"\nexport RW_API_KEY_PROJECT=\"proj-aaaa\"\nnode sampleapp.js\n# headers show org-xxxx\n```

sam: Another issue: streaming clients (WS/SSE) drop on 401 after rotation. SDK currently closes connection instead of trying a refresh+retry. We should attempt one refresh via tokenProvider.refresh() then retry the frame, else emit an event so apps can handle.

tara: +1. Also we should standardize env precedence to be explicit: RW_API_KEY_PROJECT, RW_API_KEY_SERVICE, RW_API_KEY_ORG, then REDWOOD_API_KEY fallback. Add startup diag that logs (masked) which env var was used.

devon: Add a one-time warning if both REDWOOD_API_KEY and any RW_API_KEY_* are set; CLI warns but SDK libs must be defensive too.

maria: Tests needed: unit tests for env permutations and e2e for stream rotation (simulate 401, ensure SDK refreshes or surfaces event).

infra-bot: deploy: sampleapp/dogfood v2.3.1 -> staging finished :white_check_mark:

tara: Plan: revert precedence change, prefer specific RW_API_KEY_* vars, add RW_ENABLE_TOKEN_REFRESH=true, expose TokenRefreshHandler, startup diag, and RW_LEGACY_KEY_COMPAT=true for migration.

devon: Suffix naming for RW_API_KEY_* is fine. I'll add e2e for streaming rotation.

sam: I'll prototype TokenRefreshHandler and update sampleapp to show graceful reconnect.

deploy-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1427 "SDK: env precedence + streaming token-refresh on rotation"

maria: Action items: tara open PR + link issue; devon add e2e; sam write mid-stream 401 test; maria update onboarding docs to recommend removing REDWOOD_API_KEY when using project keys. Thanks all — keep changes small and opt-in, ship warning ASAP.
